reasons.claim: Both readers accurately capture the single chain from al-Saduq's father through the unnamed elevation gap to Bashir al-Dahhan and Abu Abdillah, omitting the honorifics.
reasons.quote: أَبِی ره عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِیسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ یَرْفَعُهُ إِلَی بَشِیرٍ الدَّهَّانِ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ع قَالَ:

reasons.claim: Both readers correctly place Muhammad b. al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar as co-transmitters at the first level and exclude the wording gloss.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن المثنى، وابن، بشار - واللفظ لابن المثنى - قالا حدثنا محمد، بن جعفر

reasons.claim: Both readers correctly keep the unnamed narrator after Abu Sa'id al-Khudri as the final link before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن أبي سعيد الخدري، قال أخبرني من، هو خير مني أن رسول الله

reasons.claim: Both readers omitted Jabir's father as the final link, even though Jabir explicitly asks him what the Prophet concealed and his father answers by relaying the Prophet's words.
reasons.quote: فقلت لابي: ما الذي أخفى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله؟ قال: قال: كلهم من قريش

reasons.claim: The father is named only by relation in the encounter, so he is added as a bare relation link after Jabir b. Samura.

levels.surface: أبو بكر أحمد بن محمد بن عبيد النيسابوري

notes: Jabir asks his father what the Prophet concealed and his father answers with the Prophet's words, making the father a relation link after Jabir (rulings 3 and 9).

reviews.uncertainty_note: Jabir heard the first clause directly from the Prophet before asking his father for the concealed clause, so treating Jabir alone as the last link is an alternative reading, though rulings 3 and 9 include the one asked who answers.

reasons.claim: Both readers accurately group the three co-transmitters joined by «قالوا حدثنا» and trace the chain to Abu Hurayra.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن عبد الله الخزاعي، والحجاج، والهيثم بن جميل، قالوا حدثنا حماد، عن ثابت، عن أبي رافع، عن أبي هريرة

reasons.claim: Both readers correctly omit the two parenthetical glosses and include both the asker Abu Salama and Aisha who answers as the final link.
reasons.quote: قال أخبرني أبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن، أنه سأل عائشة عن صلاة، رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من الليل فقالت

reasons.claim: Both readers correctly include Abu Sawiyya and Ibn Hujayra in sequence up to Abd Allah b. Amr b. al-As and exclude Abu Dawud's closing gloss.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا عمرو، أن أبا سوية، حدثه أنه، سمع ابن حجيرة، يخبر عن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص

reasons.claim: Both readers accurately capture the three co-transmitters in the first group and the second isnad closing with a back-reference while omitting the gloss.
reasons.quote: وحدثنيه أبو بكر بن خلاد الباهلي، حدثنا يحيى، - وهو القطان - حدثنا سفيان، حدثني حبيب، بهذا الإسناد

reasons.claim: Both readers accurately trace the chain through the two bare relation links and include Imam Ja'far b. Muhammad named after the chain as the last link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي الدَّيْلَمِ قَالَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ

reasons.claim: Both readers accurately group the father and Uqba as co-transmitters and preserve the unnamed link before Ibn Umar.
reasons.quote: قال حدثنا أبي وعقبة، عن الأوزاعي، قال حدثني عطاء، قال حدثني من، سمع ابن عمر

reasons.claim: Both readers correctly treat Malik after «قرأت على» as the next link and end the chain at Abu Hurayra.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، قال قرأت على مالك عن أبي الزناد، عن الأعرج، عن أبي هريرة
